# Effective Go (RU) — Xarimi References

## Rəsmi Go sənədləri
- Effective Go (orijinal, ingilis): https://go.dev/doc/effective_go
- Go spec (semicolon qaydası, rune): https://go.dev/ref/spec
- A Tour of Go: https://go.dev/tour
- How to Write Go Code: https://go.dev/doc/code
- Go Code Review Comments: https://go.dev/wiki/CodeReviewComments
- Go wiki — loop variable pitfall (Serve nümunəsi): https://go.dev/wiki/LoopVariableExperiment

## Sənəddə keçilən paketlər
- fmt (çap formatları): https://pkg.go.dev/fmt
- os (File, PathError, Open/Create): https://pkg.go.dev/os
- io (Reader/Writer/ReadWriter): https://pkg.go.dev/io
- bufio (Reader/Writer/ReadWriter): https://pkg.go.dev/bufio
- bytes (Buffer — zero value): https://pkg.go.dev/bytes
- sync (Mutex — zero value): https://pkg.go.dev/sync
- sort (Interface, IntSlice): https://pkg.go.dev/sort
- net/http (Handler, HandlerFunc, ListenAndServe): https://pkg.go.dev/net/http
- html/template (Must, Execute, escapinq): https://pkg.go.dev/html/template
- encoding/json (Marshaler): https://pkg.go.dev/encoding/json
- hash (Hash32 interfeysi): https://pkg.go.dev/hash
- crypto/cipher (Block/Stream, NewCTR): https://pkg.go.dev/crypto/cipher
- runtime (NumCPU, GOMAXPROCS): https://pkg.go.dev/runtime
- net/http/pprof (side-effect import nümunəsi): https://pkg.go.dev/net/http/pprof
- flag: https://pkg.go.dev/flag
- log: https://pkg.go.dev/log
- syscall (ENOSPC analizi): https://pkg.go.dev/syscall

## Kanallar / kanal tipləri
- `chart.apis.google.com` — sənəddəki QR xidməti (qeyd: deaktivdir)

## Kitablar (devam üçün)
- The Go Programming Language — Alan Donovan, Brian Kernighan
- 100 Go Mistakes and How to Avoid Them — Teiva Harsanyi

## Qeyd
- Sənəd 2009-cu il üçün yazılıb; 2022 yanvar rəsmi qeydi: geniş yenilənmə planlanmır, müasir ekosistem (modullar, test, generics) haqqında məlumat daşıMİR (go.dev issue 28782 konteksti).
